task: Fix Lattice CLI self-development gate guidance so Codex adapter verification commands and story worktree acceptance commands are runnable against the current repository/worktree instead of stale or nonexistent entrypoints.
outcome: User runs REVIEW or DONE preflight for a Codex-adapter story and sees a command such as `node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex` when that is the wrapper present in the repo; in a story worktree, status/validate guidance points at `node bin/lattice.js ...` or `node packages/main/dist/cli.js ...` and explicitly labels stale global `lattice` as advisory fallback, so the user can say: 好了，现在 gate 让我跑的命令存在，而且不会把 main dist 当成当前 worktree 验收。
facts: B-7fc2 delivered JSON stdout contract fixes but exposed two acceptance pitfalls around stale global lattice and hardcoded lattice-codex gate hints.

packages/main/src/core/codex-adapter-checks.ts already has constants for lattice and legacy koala wrappers, but summarizeCodexEvidence currently returns LOCAL_CODEX_VERIFY_COMMAND for missing/failing/stale states.
packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts renders codex-adapter gate command labels from LOCAL_CODEX_VERIFY_COMMAND instead of resolved gate details.
packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts includes fallback text that hardcodes LOCAL_CODEX_VERIFY_COMMAND for Codex adapter reruns.

checkGlobalFallback already classifies global @koala-agent/core resolving outside the current worktree as warn/heartbeat-only; this story should preserve advisory semantics and improve command guidance/tests, not hard-fail global drift.
README and bootstrap-runner already warn that global fallback may lag a worktree, but first-step and verify sections still assume lattice-codex too strongly for legacy/full-ish repos.
constraints: Do not use Swift or Mac Native App validation as primary evidence.
Do not migrate koala.config.json to lattice.config.json in this story.
Do not force global lattice to point at a story worktree; global can remain main/global while worktree acceptance prefers local commands.
Preserve --json stdout parseability and existing legacy Koala compatibility.
